dedupe_keys.name: kokudo suchi joho a31 flood inundation zone data by river mlit national land numerical information

description: This dataset in the Kokudo Suchi Joho, the Japanese national land numerical information service, digitises the flood inundation zones designated by river administrators under the Water Prevention Act for flood forecasting and water level notification rivers, as depth-ranked polygons by prefecture. Each polygon carries a depth rank code, the producing body, designation date and notice number, the river and reach, the design rainfall such as 30-year, 50-year or 80-year events, and the municipalities involved; depth classes are five or seven ranges from below 0.5 metres to over 5 metres, depending on the river. The latest version is the 2025 fiscal year edition and earlier editions back to 2012 are listed. Coverage: national, but only rivers whose administrators supplied maps, and rivers with different design rainfalls sit in one layer. Access: free download as GML or shapefile; the licence is non-commercial only. Caveats: data are split by prefecture, so zones crossing boundaries need several files, and positional accuracy is stated as 25 metres. It supports flood exposure and evacuation analysis, and relates to the KSJ national land numerical information record already in the catalogue.
